message: Fix insecure generation of random numbers (#108)

pr.title: Fix insecure generation of random numbers
pr.body:
The miekg/dns package before 1.1.25 improperly generates random numbers because math/rand is used. The TXID becomes predictable, leading to response forgeries.

See: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-44r7-7p62-q3fr
